prompt: Which statements about Codespaces are true? Choose all that apply.
explanation: Codespaces give everyone a container environment built from a committed definition — from a browser or your editor. They sit on top of Git, not instead of it, and usage is metered, not unlimited.

options.text: A codespace is a cloud-hosted development environment
Codespaces can be opened in the browser or from supported local editors
A dev container definition makes environments reproducible
Codespaces replace the need for Git
Codespaces can run forever at no cost
